answer: An agent marketplace weights each agent's voting power by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Agents trading trellis plans, violet seedlings, or saffron all follow the same rule: splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities gives no more total voting power than locking them under one identity. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase cost and losing access to that capital during the lock.
